Farmer Murdered, Body Transported by Bicycle; Motives Vary by Report

A farmer was murdered and his body was transported by bicycle, with CCTV footage revealing the crime. In one account, the farmer had been missing for three days. The alleged motive involved the farmer being found with a village woman in objectionable circumstances, and accusations of theft. Another report stated the murder was linked to a land dispute, with the victim being run over by a tractor. Police have arrested a suspect in one case, who confessed to the murder due to a dispute over a woman and alleged theft of 900 rupees.
